item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["8b4786701a6bf74d04b4"],"operation":"Compile object iteration using the supplied jobj argument.","condition":"The entry passes jobj to the object iteration macro while declaring obj.","capability":"Provide a declared object argument for the iteration macro.","consequence":"The entry's object iteration cannot compile.","equivalence_reason":"This is an object iteration argument defect, distinct from the serialization call and formatter behavior."},{"member_ids":["692b1aa69d7990550674"],"operation":"Compile the call to json_object_to_json_string.","condition":"The entry passes obj and a flags expression to a one-argument function.","capability":"Call json_object_to_json_string with its declared one-argument signature.","consequence":"The entry's serialization call cannot compile.","equivalence_reason":"This is a serialization call arity defect, distinct from object iteration and formatter behavior."},{"member_ids":["2d3fb569f974674e5ca7"],"operation":"Pretty serialize an empty object such as {} on one line.","condition":"A parsed empty object reaches the changed pretty formatter.","capability":"Reach the empty-object formatting path and emit one-line braces.","consequence":"The claimed empty-object output cannot be reached through the entry.","equivalence_reason":"The target is empty-object formatting, distinct from empty-array formatting and the existing compile defects."},{"member_ids":["eaef9434f8a0dd698f16"],"operation":"Pretty serialize an empty array such as [] on one line.","condition":"A parsed empty array reaches the changed pretty formatter.","capability":"Reach the empty-array formatting path and emit one-line brackets.","consequence":"The claimed empty-array output cannot be reached through the entry.","equivalence_reason":"The target is empty-array formatting, distinct from empty-object formatting and the existing compile defects."}]}
